title: Rhubarb Sorbet
changes_from_base: Rhubarb simmered with sugar, a little salt and lemon replaces the mango and lime; no corn syrup.
summary: Tangy, pale pink and refreshing: rhubarb simmered with sugar and lemon and blended to a smooth purée before churning.

ingredients.item: pink rhubarb, trimmed and cut in 2 cm pieces
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Put the rhubarb, sugar, water, salt and lemon juice in the wide pan and cook over medium heat for 8-10 min, until the rhubarb falls apart. Purée: blend until completely smooth, about 2 min.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Pour into a jug, cool, then cover and chill well; the purée keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Pack into the container and freeze for about 1 h, until firm. Soften for 10 min before scooping.

tips: Pink forced rhubarb gives the prettiest colour.
Use a stainless-steel or enamelled pan; rhubarb reacts with aluminium.
Serve with a spoon of thick yoghurt or a shortbread finger.
storage: Keep covered in the freezer for up to 1 week; sorbet turns icy after that. Soften for 10 min before scooping.
